records.description_rewritten: Antonis Tritsis Metropolitan Park spans the Agioi Anargyroi, Ilion and Kamatero area in western Athens. The original cruising directory gives a specific but undated clue: benches near the Bibiza street side of the park. This huge public ecological park has ponds and bird habitat; its source page contains no visitor comments at all. A metropolitan environmental authority independently confirms the Bibiza entrance, public bus access and nature education activities, but provides no evidence of cruising.

records.access_conditions: Public ecological park with protected bird populations, water bodies and recreation routes; visitor and habitat rules apply. The regional site confirms the Bibiza access and bus stops but no dedicated adult facility or reliable nightlife access hours.

records.description_rewritten: The landscaped grounds around Zappeion Megaron are a long-standing cruising-directory entry in central Athens. The directory points to the fountain south of the main building and nearby planting, but its assertions of constant high traffic and sexual encounters have no date. June 2026 commenters discuss visiting and one describes the men as appealing; a February 2026 firsthand visitor says the park was empty that night. These support some recent onsite attention without proving any particular encounter. The National Garden next door is separately gated and closes at sunset, so do not confuse it with the Zappeion grounds or promise all-night access.
records.location_identity: Zappeion Megaron grounds by fountain south of exhibition hall, Vasilissis Olgas/Sofias avenues central Athens; exact meeting zone from source not validated by operator.
records.access_conditions: Public landscaped areas used by daytime visitors and event guests. Adjacent National Garden expressly open sunrise to sunset with gates; this should not be applied automatically to Zappeion Park. Event-hall facilities and planted zones require independent permission.

This supports recent unsuccessful visits rather than a verified current cruising scene; the undated 'all day' label is not reliable operator opening information.

records.description_rewritten: Limanakia B is one of the steep rocky coves of the Athens Riviera between Vouliagmeni and Varkiza. It is widely described as a gay-friendly, clothing-optional sunbathing/swimming spot by the city's official visitor guide and independent gay travel publications. The nearby original Limanakia A source refers to bus stops and rocky ledges, while B's exact page returned a 451 access error. Some sources distinguish the second cove, popular with nude gay bathers, from a third cove more explicitly associated with cruising; a gay beach is not automatically proof of sexual activity in a specific B section. The general guides have no eyewitness post-November-2025 encounter reports.
records.location_identity: B Limanakia bus-stop and second rocky cove on Poseidonos/EO91 coast road, near Vouliagmeni 16671; distinct from A (index 525) and C deeper cove.
records.access_conditions: Rocky steep pedestrian descent from coastal roadway. Limited facilities, no sand, deep water and slippery ledges; daylight beachgoing strongly safer than unlit climbs. Bus route 122 may serve B Limanakia; verify current operator timetable. Beach nudity/sexual conduct and environmental rules subject to local law and consent.
